description: Main source code for sensor data acquisition and display on the X-NUCLEO-IKS01A3 platform using Zephyr RTOS, involving multiple sensors with trigger-based and polling mechanisms.

methods.name: lis2mdl_config
methods.description: Configures the LIS2MDL sensor, sets sampling frequency, and optionally sets trigger.

methods.name: lps22hh_config
methods.description: Configures the LPS22HH sensor, sets sampling frequency, and optionally sets trigger.

methods.name: stts751_config
methods.description: Configures the STTS751 temperature sensor, sets conversion rate, and optionally sets trigger.

methods.name: lis2dw12_config
methods.description: Configures the LIS2DW12 accelerometer/gyroscope, sets sampling frequency and full scale, and optionally sets trigger.

methods.name: lsm6dso_config
methods.description: Configures the LSM6DSO accelerometer, gyroscope, and temperature sensors, sets sampling frequencies and scales, and optionally sets triggers.

methods.name: lis2de12_config
methods.description: Configures the LIS2DE12 accelerometer/gyroscope, sets sampling frequency and full scale, and optionally sets trigger.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing sensors, configuring them, and entering a loop to fetch, display sensor data, and print trigger counts.
